steps.what: Find and check current institutional guidance relevant to the student organization's actual question
outputs: Relevant checked guidance or an unresolved question for its owner

steps.what: Act as adviser to the student organization by listening, discussing options and guiding students on their actual activities
outputs: Students' understanding and their own next decisions

tasks.design: Configure native search and links in {DOCS} for existing organization guidance. The teacher remains the live adviser and resolves ambiguous guidance with its owner.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current institutional guidance can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search and source links can reduce that lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Advice depends on students' aims, responsibilities and actual circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, challenge assumptions and support students' own decisions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document search can support guidance lookup while student advising remains conversational work.

assumptions: Conditional advice episode with actual guidance lookup; no measured baseline. Institutional owners already produce guidance; teacher retrieval and checking remain in s1.
Native features first; existing equivalent links earn no saving. Missing or ambiguous guidance stays manual.
No meeting minutes, event approval, message or record write is established by this task; none is invented or silently automated.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: lookup saving 3 less upkeep 1 gives net 2.
research_questions: Which source pages are repeatedly difficult to locate?

incremental.description: Maintain links to current organization guidance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional lookup saving 3 minus upkeep 1; live advising remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find candidate specialized materials for the actual atmospheric, earth, marine or space science reading assignment
inputs: Existing institutional library catalogue and discipline repositories, defined as OTHER
outputs: Candidate sources with real catalogue records or full texts

steps.what: Read and evaluate candidate materials and select sources appropriate to students and the assignment
outputs: Teacher-selected sources and confirmed source records

steps.what: Import exact metadata for selected source records into the existing reference manager
inputs: Existing reference manager, also defined as OTHER
outputs: Staged references linked to source records, with missing fields marked

steps.what: Compile the bibliography from selected imported references in the teacher's chosen citation style
Check every final bibliography entry against its actual source, correct metadata and verify assignment access
Publish the exact checked bibliography to the assignment

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} library search, reference import and citation formatting to compile the selected reading list. The teacher reads and selects sources and verifies the complete bibliography before publishing it in {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual metadata transcription and citation formatting repeat source-record information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference-manager imports and style rules can preserve exact source metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Academic quality, relevance and reading difficulty require subject judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose material that serves the actual assignment and students.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: library search, structured reference imports and citation styles can reduce metadata transcription and formatting without selecting readings.

assumptions: Conditional manual-reference workflow, not a measured baseline. Catalogue publishers and libraries produce source records; teacher source discovery, reading and selection are counted in s1-s2.
Native tools first; existing imports and citation formatting are baseline and earn no new saving. No invented references, inferred missing metadata or model-only source exclusion.
Missing or conflicting metadata remains human work in s5. Every final entry and access route is checked before publication; edits require another check.
Publication takes approximately no time today and remains fully retained. All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross 4.5 plus 25 plus 10 equals 39.5; upkeep 4 gives net 35.5.
unknowns: Existing reference-manager use and source metadata quality
research_questions: Which reference fields are still transcribed manually after native imports?

already_counted.description: Retained search, academic source selection and complete final bibliography verification

incremental.description: Maintain import mappings and citation styles and handle schema changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete bibliography checked in s5; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual discovery, metadata and formatting saving 39.5 less upkeep 4; existing equivalent features yield zero new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Find and check the current event time, location and actual participation instructions
Participate in the actual campus or community event and interact with its participants

tasks.design: Use the existing {CALENDAR} event and native {EMAIL} search to locate organizer updates. Actual event participation stays with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event details can require repeated searching through updates.
tasks.enabler_now: Native invitation links and search can reduce that navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Presence and interaction are the substance of participation.
tasks.human_edge: Engage with participants and respond to the live situation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native calendar and email features can locate event details while actual participation remains human.

assumptions: Conditional event episode with actual information lookup; no measured baseline. Organizer authors invitations; teacher checking remains in s1.
Use native features first. Existing calendar reminders and links are baseline, with zero new saving where already effective.
No separate registration send, attendance record, report or follow-up is established by the task. Do not manufacture these activities or reduce actual participation.
All 100 illustrative focal effort points: gross lookup saving 2 less upkeep 0.5 gives net 1.5.
research_questions: Does observed event preparation include repeated avoidable navigation?

incremental.description: Maintain event source links where needed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional lookup saving 2 less upkeep 0.5; actual participation retained.

tasks.short: Answer public and media questions with checked scientific content

steps.what: Clarify the actual public or media question and find relevant existing scientific source material
inputs: Actual question from the public or media
Scientific library and repositories, defined as OTHER
outputs: Clarified question and candidate source material

steps.what: Read and verify the relevant scientific evidence and its uncertainty for this question
Determine the scientific answer, its scope and how to explain uncertainty to the actual audience
inputs: Verified evidence and uncertainty from s2
outputs: Teacher-authored answer points and source references

steps.what: Draft the written answer from the teacher's actual answer points, revising wording against those points and sources
inputs: Teacher-authored points and verified references from s3
outputs: Complete written answer draft with uncertainty preserved

loop.purpose: Express the teacher's answer clearly without changing its scientific meaning
loop.input: Actual teacher-authored answer points and verified sources
loop.output: Written answer preserving scope and uncertainty
loop.check: Teacher compares every claim with the supplied points and source passages
loop.stop: Stop on missing evidence, changed meaning or unresolved uncertainty and return to teacher authoring
loop.why_not_simpler: The explanatory wording varies with the real question and audience; a fixed form only handles the surrounding fields

steps.what: Check the complete final answer, references, audience and any actual institutional speaking constraints
outputs: Exact checked final answer for the named recipient

steps.what: Send the exact checked answer to the public or media requester
inputs: Exact final answer and recipient checked in s5

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} scientific-library search and a bounded wording loop in {DOCS} from the teacher's verified answer points. The teacher checks the complete final answer before a separate {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding appropriate sources and adapting wording to a specific audience can take repeated effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search supports discovery and a source-bound prose loop can help express an already-authored scientific answer.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific correctness, uncertainty and public interpretation require subject expertise.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the evidence supports and explain its limits responsibly.

ambition.what: Support the existing written public response.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound language drafting can assist explanation wording but requires expert claim-by-claim checking and does not establish scientific truth.

assumptions: Representative written-answer episode, not a universal baseline for live interviews or all public questions; do not apply these weights to live speech without observation.
Teacher source discovery, full evidence reading, answer reasoning and answer-point capture are all counted in s1-s3. No free pre-authored expert answer or cleaned source feed.
Native search and fixed response fields first; only variable explanatory prose uses the loop. Missing facts stay missing, and uncertain claims are not strengthened.

Assumes the teacher is actually permitted to answer this question. If institutional authorization is required, its owner must review the complete final version before s6 and their labour must be added; no automatic speaking authority.
Existing search or drafting automation earns no new saving. No extra press release, archive save or follow-up send is hidden.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 4 plus 5.7 equals 9.7; upkeep 2 gives net 7.7. Sending is retained with no saving.
unknowns: Actual written versus live response mix and institutional approval practice
research_questions: Can wording support preserve every uncertainty and source claim with less total teacher effort?

already_counted.description: Source finding, evidence evaluation, actual scientific answer reasoning, retained prose review and full final checking

incremental.description: Maintain source-bound drafting instructions and examine output failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete answer and recipient checked in s5; any wording or recipient change requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional written-answer lookup and prose saving 9.7 minus upkeep 2; evidence reasoning and final send checks retained.
